entities.name: Kuno II of Falkenstein

entities.summary: Kuno II von Falkenstein, also known as Konrad II von Falkenstein-Münzenberg, was a German nobleman and theologian who served as Archbishop and Elector of Trier from 1362 until his resignation in 1388.
